production_binding: Compile against the exact clean current Q01 revision and require its successful production closure receipt.

driver_adapters_required: Register a dormant fixed-only Q01 runtime module and kqp_runtime metadata profile. Reject baseline phase because pinned main has no KqpRangeMinMax callable.
Use render_cpp_suite with len(cases()), stream returned bytes into the existing source memfd and keep object/executable/diagnostics anonymous.

Require all42 case verdicts to pass, positive executed checks, matching exit status, operator_instances=1, cleanup_live_rows=0, exact lifecycle limit_rejections/cycles and matching generator digest.
Keep these runtime contracts separate from paired SQL semantics and physical-plan evidence. They cannot by themselves mark Q01 optimization quality fully verified.

actual_runtime_observations: Production MIN/MAX output rows checked against an independent full-scan Int64 frame oracle.
Mixed composition executes the production outer collector, WinFrame and Length, while preserving the precomputed MIN/MAX fields.
Input fetch/yield and output/yield counts; unique live input-row witnesses and cleanup.
MiniKQL allocation/offload counts, cumulative offloaded bytes, lifetime peak growth and current-usage samples.
Real allocator-limit exceptions at first/later queue-growth charges, unchanged failed offload count, and released charge after graph invalidation.
Four successive graph invalidations/restarts against the same compiled graph.
limitations: Int64 payloads only; SQL typed coverage is separate.
Source fetch/allocation counters are measured, internal deque comparisons are not instrumented.
Allocator-limit rejection covers reserve accounting before allocation; std::vector allocation-failure injection is not included.
Public allocator metrics are process-local MiniKQL accounting, not RSS.
Peak deltas measure growth above the allocator prior high-water mark; sampled_used_delta measures observed runtime usage above its prepared-graph baseline. Neither is a query RSS bound.
Mixed mode uses the real collector and frame length; full RBO lowering and other native functions remain SQL acceptance responsibilities.
GetUsed modulo-page cleanup check assumes no unrelated offloaded allocations enter the fixture; native validation is still required.
